tasks.notes: Root cause: ActiveLivestock.cshtml L5 cast ViewData["Farms"] as List<dynamic> instead of IList<FarmSummaryDto> from IFarmService.ListAsync; result always empty list → dropdown never renders authorized farms → farm filter broken. Gaps: Sales farm filter missing; Profitability date filters missing; 3 mobile report pages missing (only MobileProfitLoss existed).
